profile.headline: WMS Solutions Architecture. Engages SCRUM and software engineering teams  in warehouse automation, robotics and systems. Bridges GAPs between API development and real-world operations.
profile.summary:
I’m a Solutions Architect specializing in WMS, warehouse automation, robotics, and enterprise software—bridging the gap between business needs and systems that can actually be built, deployed, and supported.
My experience centers on translating complex and sometimes ambiguous customer needs into scalable technical solutions across system upgrades, migrations, expansions, integrations, and change orders.
I’m especially interested in the intersection of requirements engineering, solution architecture, and AI.
Outside of my professional work, I build enterprise-style applications to deepen my hands-on engineering skills. Recent projects include a Java 21 / Spring Boot change-order system using REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Docker, validation, and layered architecture to model real enterprise request workflows.
More recently, I’ve been building an AI-assisted engineering application focused on evidence-grounded requirements analysis. The system is designed around traceability, human-in-the-loop review, requirement lifecycle management, versioning, tamper-evident audit history, structured AI output validation, and safeguards that prevent AI-generated content from bypassing human approval.
My strengths include:
• Turning ambiguous business needs into structured technical solutions
• Requirements engineering, traceability, and solution design
• Understanding how enterprise systems behave in production—not just on paper
• Designing solutions developers can realistically implement and support
• WMS, warehouse automation, robotics, integrations, and enterprise modernization
• Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Docker, and modern web technologies
• Applying AI to engineering workflows with evidence, validation, and human oversight
• Improving estimation, forecasting, and engineering planning
I’m passionate about systems thinking, clean architecture, AI-assisted engineering, and building tools that make technical teams more effective.

projects.title: Change Order Requests API | GitHub: https://github.com/verrydav/change-order-system
projects.description: Built a production-style Spring Boot REST API using Java 21 with clean layered architecture, JPA/Hibernate persistence, Flyway migrations, and PostgreSQL, including service-layer business logic, actuator diagnostics, and robust error handling.
